title: The Vera panel and phone tab bar rest on the open footer, and the phone drawer shows Circle pictures

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-19 design list (30 items), items 3 and 22; 2026-10-20 audit

detail: The 2026-10-20 audit found two shell gaps. Item 3: the docks rose with the open mega footer (LIVE-1030), but the open Vera panel stayed at its fixed corner and covered the footer, and the phone tab bar ignored the lift. Both now read --fq-foot-lift. Item 22: the left rail drew each Circle's picture (LIVE-1013), but the phone drawer's Your Circles still drew a generic circle icon because members-shell dropped the image. The drawer now draws the same CircleMark.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');const h=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/header.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/\.fqd-wrap\{bottom:calc\(24px \+ var\(--fq-foot-lift/.test(c))bad.push('Vera panel does not follow the footer');if(!c.includes('env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--fq-foot-lift, 0px)'))bad.push('tab bar does not follow the footer');if(!h.includes('<CircleMark label={c.label} image={c.image} />'))bad.push('drawer Circles have no pictures');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1043: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Vera panel or tab bar stops following the footer, or the drawer loses Circle pictures. Behavior is dock-lift.test.ts.
